text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was working late refining the race 
schedule, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
We've both been overworking ourselves 
lately. You, and me too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you cannot discern when to wield your 
power, you are no mighty warrior—merely an 
unruly beast—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"How about we both give ourselves some 
leeway? If you have any thoughts, would 
you care to share?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna scolded me. Considering my 
accumulated fatigue, I should probably 
revise my upcoming schedule...
